svg.text: GS-4 two-genre practice — compact essays vs decision memos
gs-4-practice · theory (Part A) and case studies (Part B) need different muscles, one clock
PART A — THEORY (7-8 min each)
line 1: define the concept (quote only if exact)
2-3 analytical dimensions · one micro-example each
boundary nuance ("empathy without regulation…")
close: officer-relevance in one line
rubric /10 — definition 2 · depth 4 · examples 2 · close 2
PART B — CASE (16-18 min each)
first 3 min: annotate paper — actors · verbs · constraints
7 steps: facts → dilemma → stakeholders → options ≥3
→ evaluation tests → decision + implementation
last 2 min: SAFEGUARDS — the most-skipped band
rubric /20 — structure 4 · honesty 4 · tests 4 · decision 5 · safeguards 3
EXAMPLE ARMOURY
rule ↔ situation pairs (conduct rules · RTI · disaster manuals)
officer one-liners: Seshan neutrality · Sreedharan delivery
concept hooks: Gandhi's talisman · Rawls · Kautilyan audit
refresh Sunday — one new pair per week minimum
WEEKLY LOOP
Mon/Wed 2 theory · Tue/Thu 1 case · Fri sectional (3+2, 100 min)
Sat peer-evaluate on rubrics · Sun rewrite the worst
voice: first person · lawful floor · humane tone · recorded steps
no heroics as first moves — exhaust the institutional ladder
